title: Klint Kubiak: Raiders QB1 is Kirk Cousins' job to lose

sources.name: Yahoo Sports NFL
sources.title: Klint Kubiak: Raiders QB1 is Kirk Cousins' job to lose
sources.description: Kubiak said he liked what he saw from Fernando Mendoza in the preseason opener, but Cousins has been working with the first string and will continue to do so.
